build_down_block_1d: build a DownResnetBlock1D with configurable resnet layers and optional downsampling for 1D UNet encoder
build_up_block_1d: build an UpResnetBlock1D with skip connection concatenation and optional upsampling for 1D UNet decoder
build_mid_block_1d: build a UNetMidBlock1D with resnet and self-attention layers sandwiched between downsample and upsample
build_attention_block_1d: build a SelfAttention1d module with multi-head attention, group normalization, and residual connections for 1D sequences
build_out_block_1d: build an OutConv1DBlock output head with conv1d, group norm, activation, and final projection layer
